HOW TO PLAY

🌊

Reload in Water

Your water gun uses ocean water. Stand in the sea to reload your ammo!

✨

Collect Coins

Defeated turtles drop coins. Collect them to upgrade your weapon between waves.

🏰

Defend the Burrow

Deposit coins at your Burrow to spawn Minion Crabs to help you fight.
